title: Seventh amendment: drum-only zero-input window proof on the actual processor output
frozen_before: any reevaluation or actual-002 measurement under the corrected injected scenario

supersedes.note: Additive. Amendments 1-6, their receipts, and the preserved actual-full-001 artifacts remain immutable history. Original predeclared.json, protocol.sha256 and all prior contracts/pins/receipts are preserved.

reason: The injected scenario proves transport wiring via engine getters, but not that the actual processor output carries internal-kit drums. A generic output-nonzero check includes the guitar input and cannot attribute output to the kit. Add a declared zero-input window that measures the real processor output with the embedded kit.

drum_only_window.procedure: After the third-join resync phase proof, while the engine is playing, switch the input generator to declared silence (input_kind=silence, wav=nullptr) so every callback buffer is written exact-zero by the caller. Run 0.5 s of paced callbacks as a wash (guitar/filter tails after the prior clean signal), then measure 1.0 s of paced callbacks. In the measured window record the actual processor output RMS/peak/nonzero blocks, the injected steps delta, engine playing, internal-kit samplesLoaded()==true and drumEngine.useVst.load()==false.
drum_only_window.rationale: With zero input and the embedded kit loaded (use_vst=false), any nonzero output plus growing injected steps is internal-kit output from the real product chain, not the guitar input. This is INJECTED CONTRACT evidence, not a real-guitar or physical-device claim.
drum_only_window.gate: injected join gate requires zero_input_declared=true, sampler_loaded=true, use_vst=false, sample_count >= sample_rate, rms/peak > 1e-7, nonzero_blocks > 0, steps_delta > 0, engine_playing=true, allocator_coverage=unmeasured.
drum_only_window.scope: The window is unarmed, so callback allocator counters are not claimed for it; the 54-cell RT gate is unchanged. This window does not alter the 54-cell matrix coverage or expected ids.

semantics_unchanged: structural AND rt_gate AND join_gate; default no-lock diagnostic; the 54-cell matrix, pacing and expected ids are unchanged. Only the injected scenario gains the drum-only output proof.

preserve.canonical_wav_bytes: make_synthetic_evidence.py WAV generation unchanged; selected source WAVs and absolute-frame phase metadata unchanged
